fusions.name: Scattered Shoal
fusions.desc: Flings 4 slick scales in a spread; each one deals 11 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting Silverside
fusions.desc: Spits a darting bead of water from hiding that deals 7 damage, with a 50% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds, and 40% more critical chance against a target nothing has wounded yet. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions on you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Fingers
fusions.desc: Every time you slip a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.4 health a second.
